fields.name: ACCT-ID
fields.description: Account identifier — unsigned numeric, stored as StringType to preserve leading zeros

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-BAL
fields.description: Current balance — signed zoned decimal with 2 implied decimal places; last byte carries ASCII sign overpunch

fields.name: ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
fields.description: Credit limit — signed zoned decimal with sign overpunch

fields.name: ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT
fields.description: Cash credit limit — signed zoned decimal with sign overpunch

fields.name: ACCT-OPEN-DATE
fields.description: Account open date in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE
fields.description: Account expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format (note: original copybook typo 'EXPIRAION' preserved)

fields.name: ACCT-REISSUE-DATE
fields.description: Account reissue date in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
fields.description: Current cycle credit amount — signed zoned decimal with sign overpunch

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
fields.description: Current cycle debit amount — signed zoned decimal with sign overpunch

fields.name: FILLER
fields.description: Reserved padding to reach RECLN 300 — dropped during parsing
